cues: Heterosis, or hybrid vigour: the F one of two inbred lines outgrows both parents.
And inbreeding depression: maize selfed again and again gets weaker.
Save seed from a hybrid, and the F two segregates and loses its vigour.
That is why farmers must buy hybrid seed fresh every season.
And the newest goal is biofortification: crops richer in iron, zinc or vitamins.
